pages.text: When quality is enabled, harvested raw leaf receives a $(thing)Growth Quality$() score from 0–70. Biome, light, temperature, and harvest timing contribute to the result, followed by a small random harvest roll. The Spectacles show the deterministic potential as a range before harvest.
Raw-leaf tiers use the 0–70 scale:$(br2)$(4)0–15 Poor$()$(br)16–30 Common$(br)31–45 Good$(br)46–59 Excellent$(br)$(2)60–70 Perfect$()
pages.title: Raw Leaf Tiers

pages.text: The Spectacles' environmental Conditions rating ignores age: $(2)Excellent$() at 18+, $(2)Good$() at 10–17, $(item)Fair$() at 0–9, and $(4)Poor$() below 0. This tells you whether the farm site is good, not whether the crop is ready.
pages.title: Conditions Rating

pages.text: Harvest timing is separate and important. Stage 7 receives the best timing score. Stage 6 is noticeably worse. Stages 0–5 receive a strong penalty. Curing can improve good leaf, but it cannot fully undo a premature harvest.
pages.title: Harvest Timing
